profile.description: Active four-day admission-free county fair welcoming 20,000+ attendees. 2026 fair is Sept. 17-20 and includes a carnival, food, games, entertainment and family activities. Adventure Zone emailed Aug. 13; no reply has been found.

notes.subject: Aug. 29 Gmail audit — one call is the next step
notes.body: Adventure Zone sent 2026 outreach Aug. 13 to Jim Logan's older latah.id.us address and the current fair@latahcountyid.gov address. Gmail recheck Aug. 29 found no reply. Current official information identifies Jim Logan as Director and the fair office number as 208-883-5722. Because the fair already has a carnival and another email would repeat the same pitch, the next action should be one phone call asking whether there is room for a supplemental staffed attraction area. Log the answer and do not keep emailing if the carnival arrangement closes the opportunity.

followUps.label: Call Latah County Fair once
followUps.reason: Call 208-883-5722 and ask whether the existing carnival arrangement leaves room for a supplemental staffed Adventure Zone attraction. Log the outcome; do not send another introductory email.
